scripts.predev: npm run check:config && npm run dev:infra
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,rag,client -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:rag" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-env.test.mjs && npm --prefix server run test && cd rag-service && python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
